Franchise.title: Franchise
Franchise.description: Represents a franchise within the Pool BR Limpeza e Manutenção system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Franchise entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns this franchise. (Relationship: User 1:1 Franchise)

contactEmail.description: Contact email address for the franchise.

contactPhone.description: Contact phone number for the franchise.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the franchise was created.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Pool BR Limpeza e Manutenção system.  This entity does NOT store authentication data. It is assumed that an external authentication system is used.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to the Franchise this user belongs to. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N User)

role.description: Role of the user within the system (e.g., master, owner, technician, client).

isActive.description: Indicates whether the user account is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client managed by a franchise.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to the Franchise that manages this client. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N Client)

contactName.description: Contact person's name at the client's location.

contactPhone.description: Contact phone number for the client.

contactEmail.description: Contact email address for the client.

poolDetails.description: Details about the client's pool (e.g., size, type).

technicianId.description: Reference to the Technician assigned to this client. (Relationship: Technician 1:N Client)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the client was added.

Technician.title: Technician
Technician.description: Represents a technician working for a franchise.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Technician entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to the Franchise the technician works for. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N Technician)

userId.description: Reference to the User account associated with this technician. (Relationship: User 1:1 Technician)

locationLatitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the technician's current location.

locationLongitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the technician's current location.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the technician is currently active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the technician profile was created.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Represents a scheduled appointment for pool cleaning and maintenance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Appointment entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to the Franchise managing this appointment. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N Appointment)

clientId.description: Reference to the Client for whom the appointment is scheduled. (Relationship: Client 1:N Appointment)

technicianId.description: Reference to the Technician assigned to the appointment. (Relationship: Technician 1:N Appointment)

scheduledDateTime.description: Date and time the appointment is scheduled to occur.

status.description: Status of the appointment (e.g., scheduled, in progress, completed, canceled).

serviceReportId.description: Reference to the ServiceReport generated for this appointment. (Relationship: ServiceReport 1:1 Appointment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the appointment was created.

ServiceReport.title: ServiceReport
ServiceReport.description: Represents a service report generated by a technician after completing an appointment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServiceReport entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to the Franchise associated with this service report. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N ServiceReport)

appointmentId.description: Reference to the Appointment this service report is for. (Relationship: Appointment 1:1 ServiceReport)

technicianId.description: Reference to the Technician who created the service report. (Relationship: Technician 1:N ServiceReport)

reportDateTime.description: Date and time the service report was generated.

chlorineLevel.description: Chlorine level recorded in the pool.

phLevel.description: pH level recorded in the pool.

servicesPerformed.description: Description of the services performed during the appointment.

photoUrls.description: URLs of photos uploaded as part of the service report.

notes.description: Additional notes or observations from the technician.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the service report was created.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure is designed to support the Pool BR Limpeza e Manutenção application, focusing on franchise, user, client, technician, appointment, and service report management. It prioritizes authorization independence and simplifies security rules through denormalization and structural segregation.

**Key Design Choices and Justifications:**

*   **/franchises/{franchiseId}**: Stores franchise information. The `ownerId` field establishes the owner relationship. Authorization rules can directly check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerId` to ensure only the owner can modify franchise data.
*   **/users/{userId}**: Stores user profiles. The `franchiseId` and `role` fields are crucial for authorization. Security rules can check `request.auth.uid == userId` for user-specific access and verify the `role` and `franchiseId` for franchise-level access. Segregating users into a top-level collection allows for easier global user management.
*   **/franchises/{franchiseId}/clients/{clientId}**: Stores client information. The `franchiseId` is denormalized to ensure authorization independence. Rules can verify `resource.data.franchiseId == request.auth.claims.franchiseId` (if using custom claims after user creation) or `get(/databases/(default)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.franchiseId == resource.data.franchiseId` (if not using custom claims). This ensures that only users within the correct franchise can access client data. The `technicianId` creates the relationship between clients and technicians.
*   **/franchises/{franchiseId}/technicians/{technicianId}**: Stores technician information. The `franchiseId` and `userId` are included. The `userId` links the technician profile to a specific user. Rules can check `resource.data.franchiseId` against a user's franchise to ensure proper access. The structure `/franchises/{franchiseId}/technicians/{technicianId}` provides good segregation to enable secure list operations.
*   **/franchises/{franchiseId}/appointments/{appointmentId}**: Stores appointment data. The `franchiseId`, `clientId`, and `technicianId` are denormalized to provide authorization independence. Security rules can validate `resource.data.franchiseId` against the user's franchise and ensure that `clientId` and `technicianId` exist within the same franchise. The `status` field enables explicit state management.
*   **/franchises/{franchiseId}/serviceReports/{serviceReportId}**: Stores service reports. The `franchiseId`, `appointmentId`, and `technicianId` are included for authorization and data integrity. Rules can ensure that the `appointmentId` references an existing appointment and the `technicianId` matches the technician who performed the service. Having service reports as subcollections ensures scalability by avoiding large collection sizes.

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**

*   Denormalization of `franchiseId` in subcollections like `/franchises/{franchiseId}/clients/{clientId}`, `/franchises/{franchiseId}/technicians/{technicianId}`, `/franchises/{franchiseId}/appointments/{appointmentId}`, and `/franchises/{franchiseId}/serviceReports/{serviceReportId}` eliminates the need for `get()` calls to parent documents (franchises or users) to determine authorization. This is critical for atomic operations and debugging.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**

*   **List Operations:** The structure enables secure `list` operations because all documents within a collection or subcollection share the same security requirements (Homogeneous Security Posture). For example, listing clients under `/franchises/{franchiseId}/clients/{clientId}` is secure because the rules can verify that the user has access to that specific franchise.
*   **Membership Maps are not used** This design uses simpler role management based on the `role` field in the `/users/{userId}` document and path based ownership of entities under franchises.

**Invariants:**

*   The structure enforces ownership through `ownerId` in the `/franchises/{franchiseId}` collection and by linking technicians and clients to franchises.
*   Timestamps (`createdAt`, `reportDateTime`, `scheduledDateTime`) are included in relevant entities to track creation and modification times. These can be used to enforce data integrity through security rules (e.g., preventing updates to `createdAt`).
*   Denormalization, while increasing storage, supports the integrity of denormalized data by allowing security rules to validate relationships (e.g., ensuring an appointment's `clientId` and `technicianId` belong to the same `franchiseId`).
